canonical_name: 关键资源内部空闲时间
formula: sum_{m in critical_resources} sum_{k>1} max(0, start[m,k]-end[m,k-1])
objective_path: assignment/sequence -> internal idle on a critical resource -> delayed critical completion -> makespan
applicability: critical resources and their ordered operation intervals can be identified
counterexample_boundary: idle outside the active critical structure may not affect makespan
degenerate_when: critical-resource order and timing are fixed across candidates

formula: std(utilization_r for comparable resources r) / max(mean(utilization_r), epsilon)
objective_path: assignment/sequence -> utilization distribution -> bottleneck/starvation pattern -> makespan
applicability: utilization is computed over comparable resource families and a common horizon
counterexample_boundary: heterogeneous resource capacities may make equal utilization undesirable
degenerate_when: only one comparable resource is used

formula: sum_o max(0, transport_ready_o - max(job_ready_o, machine_ready_o, auxiliary_ready_o))
objective_path: vehicle assignment/route/timing -> delayed material readiness -> delayed operation start -> makespan
applicability: transport readiness is explicit and separable from other readiness causes
counterexample_boundary: transport delay off the critical path may be absorbed by slack
degenerate_when: transport is instantaneous or fixed across candidates

objective_path: assignment/sequence -> unused capacity over horizon -> congestion elsewhere -> makespan
applicability: same instance, resource set and capacity convention are used across candidates
counterexample_boundary: global idle capacity can coexist with a single unavoidable bottleneck
degenerate_when: capacity and timing profile are fixed across candidates
